handoffs.message: Acceptance packet ready for review. Contains: (1) code-backed inventory of all 15 JSONL/JSON service store groups from docker-compose.yml and service code; (2) 2 write-boundary violations — incidents/postmortems shared IncidentStore write, and search-svc reading source-ingest volume directly; (3) naming collision between governance-svc and promotion-svc approval_decisions.json; (4) cross-reference to DATABASE_OWNERSHIP_AND_SHARED_CLUSTER_POLICY.md §4 ownership targets; (5) expanded acceptance checklist with gap assessment; (6) dependency map for the 3 blocked pilot tasks; (7) consultation-svc recommended as first pilot (sole write owner, no cross-service volume deps). Parent owner (Claude) needs to decide: incident/postmortem write owner, search read path post-migration, schema names for 7 stores not yet in L1, and first pilot scope.

Review approved: code-backed inventory of 15 store groups, 2 write-boundary violations, and 1 naming collision correctly identified; L1 cross-reference accurate; gap assessment honest. Parent owner (Claude) must resolve 5 open decisions before downstream pilots can start. Returning to Claude2 for closeout finalization.
